{
"cycle": 2,
"assessment": "Cycle 2 has closed the prior major gaps: current code/docs now show DeckDesignOrderTrace, nested design-order validation, structured ChartVisualApplicationGuidance including densityClass/labelBudgetClass/recommendedDownshift/aggregationRequired/narrativeFit, DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED, EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP, and SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT.    Remaining local coherence risk is narrower: stage presence can still be satisfied by semantically wrong evidence-ref namespaces, and narrativeFit is defined on chart guidance but not yet checked against actual slide role/claim-support placement. Microsoft’s chart documentation confirms that Office supports many chart families, so mdpr-skill should continue enforcing semantic order/guidance rather than renderer choices. ([Microsoft 지원][1])",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Add stage-compatible evidence-ref validation",
"why": "DeckDesignOrderTrace now prevents chartIntent-prefixed refs from backfilling source evidence, but explicit refs can still make a stage look present even if their namespace belongs to a later stage, for example visual/theme/mdpr refs passed as source_evidence. Current contracts require later stages to depend on earlier evidence and require review artifacts to carry evidence refs without becoming renderer instructions. ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add a stage-to-ref-prefix compatibility map for DeckDesignOrderTrace entries.",
"Emit a warning such as DESIGN_ORDER_REF_STAGE_MISMATCH when a ref namespace is incompatible with its stage.",
"Allow structural source refs such as sheet, rows, columns, numericCells, formulaCells, chartFamilies, errorBars, and source/evidence refs for source_evidence.",
"Reject or warn on visualApplication/density/downshift refs in source_evidence, theme refs before theme_binding_request, mdpr validation refs before mdpr_validation_refs, and reviewNote refs before review_notes.",
"Tests cover valid stage refs, misplaced later-stage refs, derived structural refs, and boundary-safe output with no raw colors, coordinates, fixed geometry, or PPTX object decisions."
]
},
{
"title": "Validate chart narrativeFit against actual slide role and claim support",
"why": "ChartVisualApplicationGuidance now records preferredSlideRoles, requiresClaimSupport, and evidenceBinding, but reviewCoherence does not yet compare those fields with actual slide intent/role or whether the chart has same-slide claim support. That leaves a valid chart recipe able to land in the wrong narrative position without a local warning.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add a local review function or ReviewCoreInput extension that accepts chart intent entries plus a semantic chart-to-slide mapping, without requiring MDPR geometry or renderer objects.",
"Emit CHART_NARRATIVE_FIT_GAP when actual slide role is not in visualApplication.narrativeFit.preferredSlideRoles.",
"Emit CHART_CLAIM_SUPPORT_MISSING when narrativeFit.requiresClaimSupport is true but the mapped slide lacks a claim/title/evidence binding.",
"Suppress the warning when the chart is mapped to an allowed slide role and has claim/evidence refs.",
"Tests cover CDF primary visual on data/summary slides, dense matrix on appendix/data slides, and invalid chart placement on section-divider style roles using semantic refs only."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [],
"duplicates_or_rejected": [
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding DeckDesignOrderTrace.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder or nested intents/recipes scanning.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding densityClass, labelBudgetClass, recommendedDownshift, aggregationRequired, or narrativeFit fields.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP, SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT, or DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED.",
"Rejected as non-local: final MDPR chart rendering, layout, theme resolution, PPTX geometry, and pass/fail validation.",
"Rejected as boundary violation: raw workbook values, raw colors, fixed coordinates, renderer object IDs, and manual visual inspection as mdpr-skill implementation tasks."
]
}

[1]: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Available chart types in Office"
